case_title: FAINUL KHAN v. STATE OF JHARKHAND AND ANOTHER
aggravating_circumstances: Use of deadly weapons, common object of murder, surrounding and preventing escape of the deceased
neutral_facts: The accused were part of an unlawful assembly that surrounded and assaulted the deceased, preventing his escape. The initial assault was made on the head of the deceased with a lathi by one of the accused. The deceased fell down and was further assaulted by two persons with spears. Another accused assaulted a witness on the head with a lathi, causing injuries. Both the deceased and the witness were taken to the hospital where their injuries were examined. The police officer-in-charge stated that he requested injury reports for the witnesses, which were made available before the charge sheet was submitted. The prosecution relied on the eyewitness accounts of the injured witnesses and the police officer's statements to establish the occurrence and the injuries sustained.
